description: Eight-track sample-based drum machine: sixteen steps per track, a knob per step for any of sixteen parameters, and sixteen memory slots holding whole patterns

params.text: Turns that step of the selected track on or off
Sets the value of the chosen parameter at that step of the selected track, which is what a parameter lock is
Makes the step knobs set the level of the selected track, step by step
Makes the step knobs set the stereo position of the selected track, step by step
Makes the step knobs set the playback speed of the selected track, step by step
Makes the step knobs set how many times the sample repeats within that step of the selected track
Makes the step knobs set where in the sample playback begins at that step of the selected track
Makes the step knobs set where in the sample playback ends at that step of the selected track
Makes the step knobs set the chance that the step plays at all, from never to every time
Makes the step knobs set whether the sample repeats between its start and end points at that step
Makes the step knobs set whether the sample plays backwards at that step
Makes the step knobs set the fade in at the start of the sample at that step
Makes the step knobs set the fade away at the end of the sample at that step, up to 4 seconds
Makes the step knobs set how much of the track's delay is heard at that step
Makes the step knobs set the delay time of the selected track at that step
Makes the step knobs set how much of the delay is fed back into itself at that step
Makes the step knobs set the filter frequency of the selected track at that step
Makes the step knobs set the filter resonance of the selected track at that step
Selects that memory slot, loading the sequences and parameter locks stored in it for all eight tracks
Marks the memory slot showing as the one to copy from
Writes the copied memory slot over the one showing
Sets the level of the stereo mix, from silence to eight times the summed tracks

inputs.text: Advances the sequence one step every eight rising edges, with the pulses in between used for ratcheting
A rising edge returns every track to its first step
Picks the memory slot, 0-10V across the sixteen

outputs.text: The left channel of all eight tracks mixed, after the master level
The right channel of all eight tracks mixed, after the master level
The left channel of that track alone, before the master level
The right channel of that track alone, before the master level

notes: no track makes a sound until a sample is loaded into it, either from the right-click menu or by double-clicking that track's window in the display
clicking a track window in the display chooses which track the step buttons and step knobs edit
a track window carries its own right-click menu, headed Track Menu, with Load Sample, Clear Track Steps, Reset Track Parameters, Clear and Reset Both, and Unassign Sample
a step knob carries its own right-click menu, with Randomize Knobs, Reset Knobs, Increase all knobs by 1 notch and Decrese all knobs by 1 notch
a step button carries its own right-click menu, with Clear All Parameter Locks for this Step, Copy Step, Paste Step, Shift Steps Right, Shift Steps Left, Randomize Steps and Clear Steps
double-clicking a step knob returns it to its default value, and holding shift while double-clicking returns every step knob of that parameter to it
the module counts eight clock pulses per step, so a sequence advances at an eighth of the rate arriving at the clock input
the step knob menu also holds Set all knobs' values to this knob's value, and two items shifting all sixteen knob values one step left or right
menu: Load individual samples — the eight numbered items under this label each load a WAV file into that track, and each prints the filename it holds
Tracks — Track #1 through Track #8, each holding Sample Position Snap Division, Clear Track Data and Unassign Sample
All Tracks — holds Shift All Sequences, which moves every track's sequence one step left or right
LCD Color Theme — Cool White, Soft Yellow, Legacy Red, Ice Blue or Data Green, setting the colour the display is drawn in
Initialize — clears everything the module holds, after a confirmation item inside the submenu
Load first 8 WAV files from a folder — opens a folder browser and puts that folder's first eight WAV files into the eight tracks in name order
Export Kit — packs the eight loaded sample files into one archive, with a list naming the track each belongs to
Import Kit — unpacks an archive written by Export Kit into a folder you choose and loads its eight samples into the tracks
Interpolation — Off, or Linear (Better Quality), choosing how the samples between two stored samples are worked out; under the Audio Quality label

inputs.0: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
